name: Nantahala RV Resort & Campground
note: Gravel RV park on Wesser Creek in the Nantahala Gorge, 12 miles west of Bryson City beside a gem-mining attraction; a different park from Nantahala Ridge Campground, 1.7 km east. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site nantahalarvresort.com (rates, features, sites gallery with 34 numbered RV sites + 3 group tent sites, 2025 photos) + Campspot booking engine read 2026-10-22: 33 RV sites in four 30/50-amp types sold by the night (max rig 50-60 ft), one-night stays bookable, no minimum -> real transient RV campground. Price gate: $35 pull-through + $5 per-stay reservation fee, under $50 (also within 40 km of the Great Smoky Mountains NP gateway, 32 km, gateways.py).
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-22: Esri Wayback NC911 leaf-off ortho (2023-02-18, 0.15 m) at 35.3264,-83.5808 shows the gravel pad area running to a narrow wooded strip with Wesser Creek's bed visible in it along the lot's east edge; Esri 2025-07-02 imagery shows RVs parked nose-to-bank along that edge; operator's own site photos (uploaded 2025-08, sites 1 and 10) show picnic tables and fire rings on open gravel a few metres from the creek with a walkable bank. Campspot sells three Creekfront RV types (23 sites). No bluff, road or developed strip between pads and creek.

fees.note: 2026 rates: Standard pull-through $35, Basic and Standard Creekfront $45, Premium Creekfront $60 a night, plus a $5 reservation fee per stay and NC sales tax. Weekly $275-325, monthly $800-1,000.

fees_source: https://www.campspot.com/book/nantahalarvresort (availability for 2 adults, Tue 2026-10-27 one night: pull-through $40.00, Basic/Standard Creekfront $50.00, Premium Creekfront $65.00 with fees; two nights 10-27..29: $37.50 / $47.50 / $62.50, so $5 per stay; Tue 2027-06-08 one night same as October) + https://nantahalarvresort.com/rates/ ('Standard RV - Pull Through Sites $35 daily', 'Standard RV - Park Sites $45', 'Premium Creek Front RV Sites $60', '* Plus NC Sales Tax and Reservaton Fee'), read 2026-10-22
flags: Entry 4250 Nantahala Ridge Campground still carries this park's Campspot fees ($35-60 + $5) and booking (flagged in audit/verify/results/applied/4250.json); they belong to this new entry.
Pinned to the RV lot on Wesser Creek; Campspot's park record (35.328391,-83.58127) and the address geocode (11 Country Rd, 35.32799,-83.58191) sit on the office/gem-mine buildings 200-250 m north.
RV Life rates it $$$ (avg_rate 42), but the operator's own rates are $35-60; the price gate passes on the posted $35 rate and the GSMNP gateway either way.
